title: No preference for generalized emergent dark energy from current cosmological data
summary: In this work, we revisit the generalized emergent dark energy model by confronting it with DESI DR2 baryon acoustic oscillation measurements, in combination with joint CMB data from ACT, SPT, and Planck, as well as Type Ia supernova samples including Pantheon$^+$, DES-Dovekie, and Union3. We find that the GEDE model remains compatible with the $Λ$CDM paradigm, with no statistically significant preference for deviations when all datasets are combined.
